name: site-footer
description: Marketing site footer: brand block with social links, titled link columns built from the nav primitive, and a bottom bar with copyright and legal links. Composition only: zero JavaScript, no controller, no reactive directives. The root is a real <footer>, so it is the page's contentinfo landmark.

brand.description: Brand column: wordmark, tagline, and social links

logo.description: Wordmark or logo. Keep it a paragraph or a link — not a heading, so the footer never enters the document outline

tagline.description: One-line positioning statement under the wordmark

social.description: Row of icon-only links. Each link needs its own aria-label; the icon inside is aria-hidden

columns.description: Grid of link columns, mobile-first: stacked on a phone, paired from the sm floor, three across from lg

column.description: One titled link group — a column-title plus a nested data-ui='nav'

column-title.description: Group heading. Give it an id and point the sibling nav's aria-labelledby at it, so each navigation landmark has a name

bottom.description: Bottom bar: copyright on one side, legal links on the other

copyright.description: Copyright line. Leave the year out — a template with a hardcoded year is wrong every January

legal.description: Wrapper for the legal nav (privacy, terms, cookies)

required_attrs: the root is a <footer> element (contentinfo landmark)
every nested nav has an accessible name via aria-labelledby (column title) or aria-label
icon-only social links carry aria-label; their icons carry aria-hidden='true'

keyboard.Tab: move through the social links, then each column's links, then the legal links, in source order

templates.html:
{brand}

{tagline}

{group_title}

{link_label}

© {company}. All rights reserved.

{legal_label}

notes: Link groups nest the nav primitive: the <a> elements inside a nav are the NAV's [data-part='link'] slots, not site-footer's. The column title sits beside the nav (a site-footer part) and names it through aria-labelledby.
Nested primitives that carry their own data-variant (nav's vertical, link's muted) must not also carry a data-part — a part's data-variant is validated against site-footer's variant values.
`faqir scaffold landing-page` copies the block between the <!-- @ui:scaffold landing-page --> markers in site-footer.html verbatim.

changes.note: The responsive ladder moves onto the breakpoint canon, mobile-first (task 0.8-09). The sheet's max-width media blocks became min-width floors on canon tiers (sm 40rem/640px, md 48rem/768px, lg 64rem/1024px), so every unconditional rule is now the PHONE case and a tier block only ever widens it. The link columns stack on a phone, pair at sm and reach three at lg; the brand column joins them at lg. The floors keep their values, so the only behavioural shift is at exactly a floor: 1024px now gets the wide layout rather than the narrow one.
